feed.text: Northbridge FC open talks with Riverside FC to sign Leo Silva before the window closes.

Northbridge FC trigger Leo Silva's release clause and are ready to pay the 60M. Riverside FC cannot block the move: it is now up to the player. New contract to stay agreed between Silva's agent and Riverside FC: 6.6M a year on a 5-year contract. Leo Silva turns down Northbridge FC and signs a new contract at Riverside FC: 6.6M a year on a 5-year contract.

picture.note: Leo Silva chose to stay at Riverside FC and signed a new contract: 6.6M a year on a 5-year contract.
